caption: The video captures a sky view with a dense gray cloud mass on the left, a blue gap of thin broken clouds upper center, and a bright sunlit cloud bank at lower left. Pale crepuscular rays slant through the hazy air above the bright edge, while the sun stays out of view. The cloud forms shift only slightly throughout the view, with the lower bright rim and the thin wisps in the blue patch changing shape and position gradually. The darker cloud on the left keeps a broad outline, though its inner texture and edges soften and change. The rays persist, their angle and brightness varying marginally against the muted blue and gray tones. The whole sky drifts slowly, the cloud banks and light shafts shifting together.
relations: Dense gray cloud mass on left keeps broad outline while inner texture and edges soften and shift gradually.
Bright sunlit cloud bank at lower left and thin wisps in blue gap change shape and position slowly.
Pale crepuscular rays above bright edge persist while angle and brightness vary marginally against muted tones.
Entire sky drifts slowly causing cloud banks and light shafts to shift together across the frame.
